title: ID0425989-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP / R6 170002092] Charging issue
description:
Reported behaviour/issue: Charging issue
Solution: NA
yyyy-mm-dd: 2025-05-01
Hello everyone,
We've been noticing anomalies at all our DC charging stations for some time now.
Here's a brief description:
- Many charging processes abort within 5 minutes.
(See both emails attached. One with the ticket number and error message, and one with the exact time steps. The issue fizzled out at the time.)
- Charging process aborts when starting a second charging process.
- After starting a charging process using an RFID card, the screen only locks after 3-4 minutes. There's a risk that someone else could possibly stop the charging process during this time.
Can you reduce the time to perhaps 90 seconds?
Ms. Ramona Hilse has already detected temperature error messages and failures of the QA15-16 DC contactors.
I can't give a specific time, as the error occurs regularly.
Thank you in advance.
Best regards,
Nils Christen
